description: Election Commission - Declare that D. A. M. Danansooriya as a member of the Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy created by a member's failure to attend council meetings, which falls under election-related administrative matters. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it concerns electoral processes and local authority membership changes.
